{{HiRez re-made note|kind=2pg}}
High-resolution (600 dpi) image, re-coloured from a white to a black border by strangewayes, of the printed Decipher card [[Lone Rogue]] (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Premium/ESB Intro 2 Player/Lone Rogue.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeSWpfeUp2cGlKY2c/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Lone Rogue.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,342,632 bytes, SHA-256 <code>8d5bef88e7eb7b57d5015c4f65029cf777635927c29405154b8e2e6fd919796c</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:ESBIntroductoryTwoPlayerGame-L-lonerogue-decipher-archive.gif]].

Credit: scan by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc..
